:::{#def-nat}
#### Nat

A **nat** is the unit of information
when the logarithm in [surprisal](#def-surprisal),
and in every quantity built from it, is the natural logarithm.

One nat is the surprisal of an outcome with probability $1/\euler$:
for an outcome $x$ of a discrete random variable $X$,

$$
\begin{aligned}
s(x) = 1 \text{ nat}
&\iff -\ln \P(X=x) = 1\\
&\iff \P(X=x) = \e{-1} = 1/\euler \approx 0.368.
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
